result:
If I could change one thing, it would be to make empathy feel as urgent and real as self-preservation.

Not just knowing people suffer, but actually feeling the weight of it in the moment — the way you feel your own pain — so cruelty becomes unthinkable and cooperation becomes the default. Everything else tends to follow from that.
